text:
morgan: Heads-up — seeing a latency spike on prod-ingest around 22:03 UTC, p95 -> ~530ms and a small uptick in 500s. I opened a hotpatch PR that touches connpool/backoff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/4823 — can someone take a look and approve if it looks ok? @oncall
sre_bot: ALERT (prod-ingest): p95 latency 530ms (+120ms), error rate +2.3% over 5m window. Triggered by increased retry churn.
alistair: looking now, grabbing logs and pprof. will comment on PR with stack snippets if I find the race
jia: I can review — running unit tests locally and sanity-checking the repro. will post CI output shortly
samir: quick skim — the change is small, mostly backoff tuning + a guard in connpool. suspicious spot: `if (conn->state == CLOSED) conn->retry()` looks racy, will leave inline note
eva: question — does this require a config rollout or feature flag flip? trying to ensure we don't need infra changes for rollout
morgan: no config changes, just code. aim is to merge and roll canary by 22:20 UTC if approved
alistair: found the race when two goroutines hit `conn->reset` — commented with suggested lock around reset, added test case snippet:
```
// repro snippet
go func(){ c.reset() }()
go func(){ c.retry() }()
```
jia: saw alistair's comment, pushing a small fix and running CI now. PTAL on my follow-up commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/commit/abcdef12345
samir: re-reviewed commit — looks good, left minor nits. nothing blocking for hotpatch. recommend squash+merge once CI green
eva: +1 on quick merge after CI. make sure canary only first, and have rollback PR ready in case errors spike
morgan: agreed — canary then gradual rollout. rollback plan: revert PR #4823 (I drafted a revert branch) and hold network layer if needed. I added the revert PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/4824-draft
sre_bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for prod-ingest at 22:16 UTC after CI success
morgan: thanks all — if anyone sees errors after canary ping here immediately. appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
jia: CI passed, merging now. will watch metrics for next 15m
alistair: watching traces and p95, looks back to normal after ~3m in canary. will continue to monitor
samir: nice, thanks team :thumbsup:
